2.3.2 Student Engagement and Attention Span Trends 
For a student to learn, their attention must be focused on the learning material, 
since if their attention is elsewhere, how are they supposed to learn from it 
(Brame, 2016). Therefore, increasing attention is a key factor in improving 
student performance. 
 
Figure 1 Screen time against age (Twenge & Campbell, 2018) 
A study by (Twenge & Campbell, 2018), shows a tendency as children get older 
the number of hours they spend per day on screens increases; with 14- to 17-
year-olds on average spending 4.59 hours per day. With screen times of one or 
more hours per day people are more likely to: have difficulty making friends, 
lower self-control, an increased risk of depression and anxiety, are less 
emotionally stable, and experience low quality sleep (Twenge & Campbell, 2018;
